question: In patients with hematological diseases, a "hemorrhagic cystitis" picture may occasionally occur. Among the multiple etiologies of this process, some viruses are included. Which of the following is the most frequently involved?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Enterovirus 71 -> infects bladder cells -> leads to hemorrhagic cystitis -> most frequently involved in hematological disease patients -> 80%
analysis: Among the viruses listed, the most frequently involved in causing hemorrhagic cystitis in patients with hematological diseases is the BK polyomavirus.
